description: Provides information about the screen and window dimensions. Allows listening to changes in dimensions (e.g., device rotation or foldable devices). useWindowDimensions is preferred in functional components.

get.description: Returns the current dimensions of the window or screen.

returns.description: Object containing width, height, scale, and fontScale

addEventListener.description: Adds an event listener for dimension changes.

handler.description: Callback function called with a DimensionsValue object

addEventListener.returns: EmitterSubscription object for removing the listener

DimensionsValue.description: Object passed to dimension change event listeners.

window.description: Size of the visible application window

ScaledSize.description: Represents a dimension with width, height, and scale factors.

width.description: Width of the window or screen in pixels

height.description: Height of the window or screen in pixels

notes: Dimensions.get() values may change after initial rendering due to rotation or device folding.
For Android, window dimensions exclude the status bar (if not translucent) and navigation bar.
Do not cache dimensions; call get() on every render if needed, or use inline styles.
useWindowDimensions hook is recommended for functional components for automatic updates.
